segments.title: Apple's new hub knows your face
segments.say: Apple's new HomeView is on sale now. And it knows your face.

segments.title: Up to six faces
segments.say: It recognizes up to six people, and keeps each person's stuff separate.

segments.title: Your texts need your iPhone
segments.say: Your texts only show when it sees you, and your iPhone is nearby and unlocked recently.

segments.title: Camera data walled off
segments.say: Apple says camera and mic data stays walled off, even from Apple.

segments.title: Not sold in the EU
segments.say: Not sold in the EU. Siri AI on it is still beta.

segments.title: SEND THIS
segments.say: Face-scanning screen in your kitchen? Send this to a friend, and follow Nexora.
